name: audit_access
description: Query who accessed a dataset (via S3 or Athena) in the last N days. Returns principals, timestamps, source IPs, and event types. Use after search_catalogue or get_dataset_detail to audit access to a specific dataset.

s3_prefix.description: S3 URI or prefix of the dataset (e.g. s3://bucket/cms_payment_history/)

table_name.description: Glue table name — used to find Athena queries against this table

days.description: Number of days to look back (1-90, default 30)
